reviewItems.title: The 2027 MLB schedule is not fully bundled in this dashboard
reviewItems.detail: The official MLB Stats API returned 2,430 2027 regular-season games, but this static dataset includes only selected special events—not all Giants/Athletics games. Missing MLB rows must never be read as free days.

reviewItems.title: MLB 2028–29 schedule data was not available in the checked Stats API
reviewItems.detail: The 2028 and 2029 regular-season queries returned zero games when checked. This is not proof of a free season or vacation window; future schedules may be unpublished or not yet populated.

reviewItems.title: 49ers 2027–29 NFL game schedules are unavailable
reviewItems.detail: The NFL schedule page has no 2027–29 regular-season game rows yet. Opponent grids and league date calendars do not supply team dates or kickoffs.

reviewItems.title: 2027 Stanford and Cal conference dates/kickoffs are not assigned
reviewItems.detail: The current official 2027 opponent grids are confirmed, but conference game dates and times are explicitly to be announced later. Known nonconference dates are shown separately.

reviewItems.title: 2028–29 college schedules are incomplete; older ACC grids are provisional
reviewItems.detail: Only individually verified nonconference dates are shown. Older 2023 ACC eight-game grids and legacy series rows are flagged as provisional and are not treated as current, complete, dated schedules.

reviewItems.title: 2026 49ers Week 18 date/time and any postseason games are TBD
reviewItems.detail: The Arizona matchup is listed without a date or kickoff. Stanford has bowl eligibility, but a bowl opponent/date/time is not assigned in the reviewed schedule. Do not invent a postseason event.

reviewItems.title: Athletics radio availability in 94122 is unconfirmed
reviewItems.detail: The 2026 official list names KSTE 650 AM in Sacramento and KVMX FM frequencies in Sacramento. The official A's Cast stream is available online; do not claim an AM/FM signal in San Francisco without a current Bay Area affiliate confirmation.

reviewItems.title: Cal's 810 AM call sign differs across official 2026 materials
reviewItems.detail: Current Cal football schedule entries call the station KSFO 810 AM; the 2026 information guide uses KGO 810 AM. The frequency and online Varsity Network listing are shown, but call-sign branding remains flagged.

reviewItems.title: Westwood One Bay Area affiliates are from a 2025 directory
reviewItems.detail: KNBR/KTCT are listed in the official NFL station finder, but it is marked 2025 and does not guarantee carriage of every 2026–29 game or resolve local conflicts.

reviewItems.title: End times and exact local on-air clearance are not published
reviewItems.detail: MLB 2:38 is a 2025 mean; football 3h is a planning estimate. WWO listings provide event slot starts but no end time; local stations may add pregame/postgame programming. End estimates are not official, and gaps are not guarantees.

reviewItems.title: Past 2026 49ers kickoff times are blank where the official schedule source did not show them
reviewItems.detail: All 2026 preseason and regular-season matchups/dates are listed. The reviewed official pages did not expose kickoff times for completed games in the extracted schedule text, so those cells remain blank rather than estimated.
